§3§lPurpose and quest§r
The Network Info Panel displays wireless EU data and real-time changes and history curves for ME items and fluids. This quest requires crafting §11§r panel. EU readings and history follow the actual wireless-account source. Panels on the same AE grid can share source identity and current sampling, while selected-entry histories remain separate for each panel and source.

§3§lPreparation and use§r
Right-click with an empty hand to open configuration. ME monitoring requires a connection to the ME network. Right-click with an item or a recognized filled fluid container to bind a chart target or add or remove live monitoring entries, depending on the active tab. Keep the panel chunk loaded.

§3§lThree display modes§r
EU Trend shows grid energy and changes. AE Trend charts one bound item or fluid with a blue stock axis and an orange change-rate axis. AE Inventory lists multiple targets with icons, stock, instantaneous changes and average changes over §1retained samples§r; it supports scrolling, grid layout, font size, bold text and icon size. Choose the mode and monitoring targets on the physical panel.

§3§lHistory recording§r
History offers §18§r nominal sampling presets: §15 minutes, 1 hour, 8 hours, 24 hours, 7 days, 1 month, 3 months and 1 year§r. Each preset retains §161§r FIFO data points. Actual coverage depends on the sampling interval and available samples; use the displayed coverage. Several curve styles are available, with Fritsch–Carlson splines as the default.

§3§lTake the screen with you§r
Bind the physical panel by right-clicking it with the Portable Wireless Network Monitor. H or Shift-right-click your own monitor opens the full remote screen; Manage HUD entries selects a simplified persistent display. The monitor uses the actual panel as its source, so its bindings do not replace the panel's ME connection or chunk-loading requirements. EU flat/rising/falling color settings also apply in the portable viewer and HUD mini charts.

§3§lCharts and source continuity§r
Bar and combined charts are also available. EU bars and EU/t lines use different units, and missing samples remain gaps. Proven source identities can survive unloading and restarts; splits, merges, account changes or device replacement may establish a new boundary instead of treating old history as the new network. A dashboard reads bound sources; a resource widget cannot inspect an arbitrary AE network.
